<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 12, 2026 - Aug 15, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Foody tracker_, Aug 15, 2026, 1/5: "Had this app for ages. Everything worked great then all off a sudden everything was behind a paywall and to scan my food I had to pay for the premium after using the app for years before."
            2. _nleberle63_, Aug 12, 2026, 1/5: "Why do you keep changing and updating the app? The updates aren’t making your app better nor are they making it easier for users. It’s annoying and I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            3. _S.t. Michael Corbin_, Aug 14, 2026, 3/5: "It won’t log all my steps from my Garmin fenix 3. Kind of pointless to buy the expensive yearly subscription when it can’t even keep track of minor things."

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      2 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 9, 2026 - Aug 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _hazicles_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Have been using the platform for a long time. It’s now full of ads to force you to buy premium. The interface has changed as well to now be more difficult to use. Such a shame"
            2. _FoDu1379_, Aug 16, 2026, 2/5: "I’ve had and used the app off and on for several years. Seems lately the goal for them to make more money has become their #1 priority. Almost $7 a month is a bit pricey for a user like myself, so I put up with the banner ads- no problem. But, with the last update…. now, after you log your first meal your greeted with a full screen ad or video where the close button, if available, is very difficult to find. I usually close the app and reopen it to get back to the app. This process is extremely annoying, and feels overblown. I’d look elsewhere if you’re new to a calorie/fitness app."
            3. _TbirdieUK_, Aug 9, 2026, 2/5: "Used to be a great app. Now the free tier is unusable due to nonstop pop up ads. Paid is £65/year. Recommend MyNetDiary, free tier much better and paid is £25/year. Interface is at least as good and I think better."
<!--/ir-theme-->
